text:
ben (SRE): Heads-up: we keep seeing PM/30/90 actions drop off. Quick proposal for a very small "handoff handshake" + fixed follow-up cadence so nothing ages out.

anya (PM): +1. we need the smallest possible process that still guarantees ownership and stakeholder comms.

ben (SRE): Proposal (TL;DR): require owner + due_date in postmortem header, bot creates tracker, reminders at 48h & Day 7, and a 2-week IC rotation with a 24h shadow/handoff. Sketch below.

keith (Eng): Make owner + acceptance_criteria mandatory. If missing, bot adds label `needs-meta` and pings #eng-oncall.

ben (SRE): minimal YAML header suggestion:
```yaml
postmortem_id: pm-<shortid>
severity: P1|P2
pattern: network|db|deploy|regression|external|config
owner: display_name
backup: display_name
due_date: YYYY-MM-DD
acceptance_criteria: short bullet list or link
```

sara (Ops): Cadence suggestion: Day 0 assign + open tracker; Day 2 check; Day 7 status update; Day 30 verification; Day 90 final close. Comms: 48h stakeholder note, weekly bullets while active, Day 30 summary.

anya (PM): Also assign a comms owner for the 48h summary (IC or PM). Keep stakeholder updates <=3 bullets.

oncall-bot: Prototype configured: will create `infra/postmortem-<id>` GH issue from YAML, apply labels, schedule reminders at 48h and Day 7, and post in #eng-oncall if unassigned after 48h.

keith (Eng): For IC rotation: 2-week blocks with last 24-48h overlap (outgoing leaves short handoff doc, incoming ACKs + shadows). Cuts context-switching.

sara (Ops): Enforce evidence before close (links to logs/dashboards or tests). otherwise block closure and flag for review.

ben (SRE): Action items: 1) ben -> add YAML to postmortem template; 2) keith -> help infra with auto-labelling rules; 3) sara -> add verification gating to tracker template; 4) anya -> draft comms bullets. Target: PRs + prototype by end of week.

anya (PM): I'll own the comms bullets. 15-min sync tomorrow to align fields?

keith (Eng): i'll pair on GH template.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: "postmortem-metadata-missing" will fire if owner or due_date absent after 24h.

ben (SRE): Nice. Small, actionable, and automatable. Thanks all — i'll post the template here after the sync.
